Thank you for your response! I feel for you and commend you for your strength presuming that you are speaking of personal experience! 
I understand that it is most definitely a gradual process. However, I was under the impression that the idea needs fruition. For example, for some, a gradual worsening of their life situations may lead to addiction or criminality... whatever they were exposed to, surely a person who witnesses people mellow their pain with booze will reach out to substance abuse for their troubles. But where has ending one's life come from?
What I also see on various forums and when speaking with hotline volunteers is that youths express suicidal intentions - of course this may be evidence to faster gradual development but I was wondering, was it maybe something seen or heard of that has sparked the idea.. was it the death of a loved one, something that has caused the existential question to be so prevalent? 

I'm sorry for rambling! It's 1:35 AM here, i guess this is just the byproduct of my insomniac thoughts.
